paper_title: Optimal Bounds for the Colorful Fractional Helly Theorem
statement: ▶ Conjecture 11 (The optimal colorful fractional Helly theorem for d-Leray complexes). Let K be a d-Leray simplicial complex with the set of vertices N = N1 ⊔ · · · ⊔ Nd+1 divided into d + 1 disjoint subsets. Let ni := |Ni | for i ∈ [d + 1] and assume that K contains at least αn1 · · · nd+1 colorful d-faces for some α ∈ (0, 1]. Then there is an i ∈ [d + 1] such that dim K[Ni ] ≥ (1 − (1 − α)1/(d+1) )ni − 1.
context: We conjecture that it should be possible to extend Theorem 7 to d-Leray complexes and probably Theorem 10 as well.
